ai.title: Baidu Open-Sources Unlimited OCR 2 for Hundred-Page Document Parsing
ai.brief: Baidu has released Unlimited OCR 2 , an open-source OCR model built for very long documents. The 3B model parses books, filings and reports of hundreds of pages in one request. Its core change is SR-SWA, a sparse attention scheme that keeps per-step decoding cost nearly flat. Weights ship under the MIT license , with code on GitHub . 34B parameters . Active parameters not disclosed. Max position length 131,072 tokens. Runs on: 1 CUDA GPU in BF16. Baidu tested on an NVIDIA A800-80GB. 7 GB. Performance: first place on both multi-page benchmarks Baidu tested, against 9 other models (self-reported). 1 overall on MarathonDocBench (hundreds of pages). 7. 2 on heading hierarchy (TEDS) on MarathonDocBench, its lowest sub-score. What is Unlimited OCR 2? Unlimited OCR 2 is a 3B vision-language model from Baidu that turns ordered page images into structured text.
